data.narrative:
DefSecIntel is a Series A-stage frontier-tech company in the Defense & Security sector. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private companies and 2 public entities operating in defense and security technology. The peer set includes Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing among private comparables, alongside public references DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. This method synthesizes three same-sector, same-stage private companies: Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M. The median valuation across this set is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This wide dispersion reflects inherent volatility in early-stage defense-tech valuations, where company maturity and technological differentiation create significant variance within a single stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, centered on a median of $400M. This range reflects reasonable downside and upside cases around the peer median. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-company peer set—particularly the $4.0B outlier—and the absence of revenue or traction metrics that would typically refine stage-based multiples. Additional methods triangulating against revenue multiples or discounted cash flow would improve confidence but are not supported by available data.
